title: Silas and the Deadline
author: Bram Amberdale
blurb: Coral Ishikawa, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
